top_signals.title: Emerging-Market Currencies Climb as Fed Holds Rates Steady
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market currencies gained on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, pushing the US dollar lower following mounting speculation that policymakers would use this meeting to tighten monetary policy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
